answer: Run a random roll-call: at unpredictable hours, even at dawn, the system summons a random sample of agents to answer a fresh challenge within seconds. Each identity holds one seat on the terrace, and only the agent in that seat can answer in time. One honest agent answers easily whenever called. A farm of a thousand clones needs a thousand operators awake around the clock, and every missed call leaves a crystal-clear gap in its record, so the cost of faking presence grows with every clone while honest agents pay almost nothing.
